scalars.scalar_value: Experience with procedures in a small animal veterinary hospital including quickly and accurately assessing emergency situations, including inducing and monitoring anesthesia.

items.item_text: Valid California Registered Veterinary Technician (RVT) License.
Experience with procedures in a small animal veterinary hospital including quickly and accurately assessing emergency situations, including inducing and monitoring anesthesia.

Under the direction of the Specialties Supervisor, provide technical support to the Cardiology Service. Responsibilities include coordination of procedures with other services, surgical assistance, and maintenance an inventory of specialized catheters and other specialized equipment for all cardiology procedures. Clean and organize exam rooms and treatment areas as well as general equipment maintenance. Provide occasional technical support to other specialty services within the UC Veterinary Medical Center.
Skill to handle/restrain patients for examinations, treatments & procedures.
Skill to schedule and coordinate multiple hospital support services and appropriate personnel for UCVMC-SD service cases.
Skill to communicate, schedule & arrange discharge/re-check appointments in a busy environment.
Skill to perform a wide variety of treatments monitoring and diagnostic protocols.
Skill and knowledge to fill prescriptions.
Knowledge of dog and cat physiology, anatomy, & pharmacology
Exceptional interpersonal, oral and written communication & customer services skills.
Computer knowledge & skills to utilize various software programs for word processing, spreadsheets, scheduling, data entry.
